verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA pill at the very top-left, so it comes before the product and headline and the reading order is backwards. Its tiny logo floats top-right on no shared edge with the CTA, the 'Now in 4-packs' line is bigger than the body copy, and the area below the text block is left empty. B keeps the right order (logo, headline, copy, product, CTA), but the top text block is cramped against the decorative circle and also has the oversized '4-packs' line. Its small CTA is wedged into the bottom-left corner almost touching the legal text, which the decorative circle overlaps.
